From the tangency condition:
\[
\sqrt{x^2+8^2}=25-8=17
\]
\[
x^2+64=289 \implies x^2=225 \implies x=\pm 15
\]
So the wheel touches the diameter only between \(x=-15\) and \(x=15\). The untouched portions are from \(-25\) to \(-15\) and from \(15\) to \(25\), total length \(10+10=20\).

\[
\boxed{20}
\]
